subject: ECE
title: Numerical Methods
description: Numerical solution of equations, interpolation, numerical differentiation and integration, and solution of systems of linear and nonlinear equations. Applications to electrical and computer engineering problems.

subject: ECE
title: Electronic Devices
description: Introduction to semiconductor devices including diodes, BJTs, and MOSFETs. Device models, biasing, and small-signal analysis.

subject: ECE
title: Embedded Microprocessor Systems
description: Introduction to embedded systems using microcontrollers. Assembly and C programming, I/O interfaces, interrupts, timers, and real-time applications.

subject: ECE
title: Probability Theory and Statistics
description: Probability theory and statistical methods applied to engineering problems. Topics include random variables, distributions, expectation, estimation, hypothesis testing, and applications to signals and systems.

subject: ECE
title: Engineering Design Project (Planning)
description: Students work in teams to select and define a design project. Includes literature review, project planning, and preparation of a formal proposal.

subject: ECE
title: Engineering Design Project (Development)
description: Continuation of ECE 405A. Design, implementation, and initial testing of the chosen project under faculty supervision.

subject: ECE
title: Engineering Design Project (Implementation)
description: Project implementation, system integration, and verification. Emphasis on meeting design specifications and constraints.

subject: ECE
title: Engineering Design Project (Completion)
description: Completion of the project, preparation of a final report, and presentation. Evaluation based on technical merit, design process, and professional standards.

subject: ECE
title: Image Processing
description: Digital image processing fundamentals. Sampling, quantization, enhancement, restoration, compression, and recognition methods.

subject: ECE
title: Digital Control Systems
description: Analysis and design of digital control systems. Discrete-time models, stability, z-transform, root locus, and state-space techniques.

subject: ECE
title: Software Design and Architecture
description: Principles and methods of software design. Architectural styles, patterns, refactoring, documentation, and design quality metrics.
notes: Elective course; often cross-listed with CS

subject: ECE
title: Software Testing, Quality Assurance, and Maintenance
description: Techniques for software testing, verification, validation, and quality assurance. Maintenance, evolution, and re-engineering of large systems.
notes: Elective course; often cross-listed with CS

subject: ECE
title: Embedded Software
description: Software for embedded systems. Topics include concurrency, real-time scheduling, device drivers, memory management, and communication protocols.

subject: ECE
title: Cooperative and Adaptive Algorithms
description: Introduction to evolutionary computation, swarm intelligence, genetic algorithms, and adaptive heuristics.

subject: ECE
title: Neural Networks
description: Artificial neural networks and deep learning. Topics include backpropagation, architectures, training algorithms, and applications.

subject: ECE
title: Computational Intelligence in Engineering
description: Overview of computational intelligence methods including fuzzy systems, genetic algorithms, neural networks, and hybrid approaches.

subject: ECE
title: Computer Security
description: Principles of computer security. Cryptography, access control, authentication, network security, malware, and secure software engineering.
notes: Elective course; often cross-listed with CS
